asked.item: Can all four pictures go out on Threads, or pick one?
API request with platform and targetType changed to threads fails with the error

verdict.reason: The pages say Threads takes 1 image or video per post and give the workaround of publishing a thread with one image per post via additionalPosts.

steps.text: Blotato's Threads publisher accepts 1 image or video per post, so a request with more than one media item fails with "Threads only supports a single image or a video".
To share multiple images, publish a thread instead, with one image attached to each post in the thread.
In your request, put each extra post in the additionalPosts array with a single item in its mediaUrls: post 1 contains image 1, post 2 contains image 2, and so on.
